NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair: Wares and Auctions
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Wares and Auctions Wares- Contact Rhiamon or Sarc for any questions and/or interest in any of these events. Labor Auction ((To be held on Sat, Jan 8th 3-5 PM PST. )) Aislings may auction off their various skills and/or time. Please try and be creative in some skills ye find. A maximum of 15 people shall be auctioned. Each will be allowed to talk for 40 minutes ((5 minutes real-time)) about their skills then bidded on. We also need an auctioneer. Each one who signs up shall be interviewed first to see what skills they have to offer. Kissing booths We need 3 males and 3 females to run these booths. A booth can be rented for use for 2,500 coins per 8 hour rental. The ones running the booth keep their profits but cannot charge more than 1,000 coins per kiss. Ware booths There will be 10 total booths, 5 used for as a bazaar (any type of acceptable item can be sold) and 5 used as specialty shops (only a specific type of item, i.e. rings, armours, weaponry, can be sold). Please spread between these two as specialty shops will make things easier to be found for the consumer. Any item can be sold that is not availible in stores (with the exception of rings) or that can be commonly found during hunting. These booths are rented out for 10,000 coins per 8 Temuairan hours and the merchant keeps any profits. Fortune Telling One fortune-telling booth will be availible at a time. The rental cost of this booth is 2,500 gold per 8 Temuairan hours. No more than a 1,000 gold charge on fortunes told. Any fortune-tellers are allowed to keep any profits they earn. Again, contact Rhiamon or Sarc for details.
